scope: Root dictionary reattachment decision for selected locally generated ASCII DXF graphs in LibreCAD_3.
reproduction: Recursive memoization cached a dictionary within a cycle as complete before discovering a missing descendant of another member; two invalid roots were reattached and one rather than three losses was reported.
implementation: Build reverse 350/360 dependencies and propagate missing targets to every predecessor; shared and cyclic graphs are visited in expected O(V+E) time. Root order and existing owner/reactor handling are retained.
validation: The generated shared-cycle regression fails before the fix and passes after it: three incomplete roots are omitted and reported, while an independent complete cycle remains named.
A 1024-dictionary shared cycle with one missing target propagates failure to both selected roots and preserves a separate complete root.
Five focused persistence tests pass, including previous root/ownerless cases and the selected IMAGE partial-resave control.
limits: The focused checks cover root reattachment and loss reporting, not complete preservation of detached objects, native import, malformed or wide handles, or the separate IMAGE source graph.
The generated DXFs are temporary and not committed.
